summary: This directory acts as the root entry point for the library, providing a unified public interface that aggregates core domain schemas, type definitions, data transformation utilities, and specialized configurations for the entire application.
responsibilities: Expose unified access to core domain modules and utility functions
Define shared TypeScript types for application-wide data structures
Provide utility functions for object manipulation and property normalization
Aggregate and export foundational schemas and architectural contracts
relationships: The directory aggregates exported symbols from child modules to provide a consistent surface area for consumers.
Type definitions for entities and configurations serve as the foundation for both system-level data validation and consumer-level usage.
Utility functions for object and type manipulation are exposed to facilitate standard data transformations throughout the application.
designDecisions: Use of a barrel file pattern to centralize and simplify module imports
Clear separation of exported domain logic, schema definitions, and internal utility types
Exposure of nominal branding types to ensure runtime and compile-time data integrity
